+"""
+Loads the bytes of an image named by a reference a user may have set
+(cut image_path, style reference URL, profile image URL, ...).
+
+Such a reference is never requested over the network. Only two kinds load:
+- data: URLs, decoded in place;
+- objects in our own storage, given as a relative path or as a URL under
+  STORAGE_HOST, read through the storage client.
+
+Everything else (any other http(s) URL, other schemes, paths that try to
+leave the bucket) is refused and yields None.
+"""
+import base64
+import re
+from typing import Optional
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+
+_SCHEME = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*:", re.IGNORECASE)
+
+
+def storage_path_for(ref: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Returns the storage object path `ref` names, or None if `ref` does not
+    name an object in our storage."""
+    if not ref or not isinstance(ref, str):
+        return None
+    path = ref.strip()
+
+    host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").rstrip("/")
+    if host and path.startswith(host + "/"):
+        path = path[len(host) + 1:]
+        # A URL's query and fragment are not part of the object path.
+        path = re.split(r"[?#]", path, maxsplit=1)[0]
+
+    if not path:
+        return None
+    # Still a URL (some other host or scheme), or protocol-relative.
+    if _SCHEME.match(path) or path.startswith("/"):
+        return None
+    if "\\" in path or any(ord(ch) < 0x20 or ord(ch) == 0x7F for ch in path):
+        return None
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in path.split("/")):
+        return None
+    return path
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(ref: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Returns the image bytes for `ref`, or None if it is missing or is not
+    a data: URL or an object in our storage. Never makes a request to an
+    address taken from `ref`."""
+    if not ref or not isinstance(ref, str):
+        return None
+
+    if ref[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        if not ref[5:11].lower() == "image/" or "," not in ref:
+            return None
+        try:
+            return base64.b64decode(ref.split(",", 1)[1])
+        except Exception:
+            return None
+
+    path = storage_path_for(ref)
+    if path is None:
+        return None
+
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+    return storage.download_image(path)

+X-Missing-Cuts header on both formats."""

+
+def export(client, headers, episode_id, fmt):
+    return client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format={fmt}", headers=headers)
+
+
+def zip_names(response):
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.content)) as zf:
+        return {name: zf.read(name) for name in zf.namelist()}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def mixed_episode(client):
+    """Cuts 1 and 4 load; 2 has no image, 3 holds a refused address and

+    h = signup(client)
+    episode_id = make_episode(client, h)
+    make_cut(client, h, episode_id, 1, image_path=stored_image())
+    make_cut(client, h, episode_id, 2)
+    make_cut(client, h, episode_id, 3, image_path="http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/")
+    make_cut(client, h, episode_id, 4, image_path=DATA_URL)
+    make_cut(client, h, episode_id, 5, image_path="cuts/test/gone.png")
+    return h, episode_id
+
+

+    r = export(client, h, episode_id, "zip")

+    entries = zip_names(r)
